dedup.scope: The public identity index, the retired-claims record and the current worklist were searched with the object names of this claim (lci projective curve, dualizing sheaf, Grothendieck-Serre duality, Pontryagin duality, perfect pairing, K/O coefficients); the one public item taken from this same source is compared directly, and only the independent statement named in the counted unit is counted.

compared.difference: Same source, different proposition: the counted public unit of doi:10.5802/jep.170 is Theorem 2.8 (source lines 537-543 with proof 549-611), the existence of the integral perfectoid Katz-Mazur model and its perfectoid formal-scheme structure. This card counts Proposition 3.7 (label LocalDualityCurves, source lines 732-745) with its own proof at 747-763, the finite-level Serre-Pontryagin duality for locally free sheaves on lci projective curves over O_K, which is an input to the later vanishing and duality results of the paper and is not a corollary of the counted integral-model theorem.
